    Chains of nonzero paths in special biserial path data #

    For admissible special biserial path data, the nonzero paths starting with an arrow a are the prefixes of one longest path Pm a (prefix_Pm), and nonzero paths ending with the same arrow are suffix-comparable (chain_suffix). Paths of positive length span a nilpotent subspace (RadGe), so a scalar plus such an element is a unit.
